list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 and this one follows on its own — there is no separate task behind it. Roughly 200 hours cover the whole list: the story hands you about half, and the rest is the long tail of stunts, challenges, vehicles and cards. Stick to the roadmap order and the chapter-save habit, because one trophy on this list cannot be recovered once missed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Play the story and pick up every mission trophy.
Clear the grind trophies in the post-story stage.
The platinum unlocks with the 54th trophy — the tracker shows what is left.

trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the mission that opens the game, all the way through. Nothing to prepare and nothing missable — it unlocks when the mission ends. Spoiler mode keeps this hidden one covered until you have it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play Gone Fishing from start to finish.

trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 1's missions and this unlocks at the chapter's end. First, though, stop at Lucia's balcony and meditate: that spot belongs to Positive Mental Attitude and disappears with the chapter. A manual save at the chapter's start is cheap cover.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Save by hand when Chapter 1 begins.
Meditate at Lucia's balcony spot before the chapter closes.
Finish all of Chapter 1's missions.

trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 2 to its end. Breakfast Run is the mission that matters here — after it, you can swap between Jason and Lucia, and the partner trophies are built on that swap. Save manually at the chapter's start, same as before.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete every mission in Chapter 2.
After Breakfast Run, swapping between Jason and Lucia is available.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Robbery work opens properly in this chapter: jewelry jobs appear, which brings Sneakthief into reach. Beyond that it is a straight story trophy — missions in order.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete every mission in Chapter 3.
Jewelry store jobs are available from this chapter onward.

trophies.guide: See Chapter 4 through. Near its end, an optional bank-vault mission appears — take it, because the vault trophies hang off it. Then save by hand before the final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete every mission in Chapter 4.
Accept the optional bank-vault mission near the end of the chapter.
Save by hand before the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and this gold is yours. The open world stays open for cleanup afterwards — just confirm the missable meditation trophy first, since there is no replay or New Game Plus to return with.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the final mission to its end.
Keep the manual save from before the final mission in case anything goes wrong.

trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Beyond the trophy, this mission switches on swapping between Jason and Lucia — the partner trophies need that. The story hands it to you in order.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist to its end. It lies on the main story route, so it shows up by itself as you play, with no side requirement and nothing missable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist mission when the story reaches it.

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Another one that follows the story: take it when it comes and it unlocks at the end.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the Child's Play mission when the story reaches it.

trophies.guide: Play Headliners through. A plain story trophy — the mission in order, no setup, no catch.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the Headliners mission when the story reaches it.

trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission at the airport. It arrives in story order on its own. Keep the airport in mind for later: the unscheduled-departure trophy is a separate free-roam stunt there, not part of this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission when the story reaches it.

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Story-path trophy — finish the mission when it comes and move on.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission when the story reaches it.

trophies.guide: Hit 100% completion for this gold. You only see the checklist after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), but everything you did before then already counts — start the big numbers early. The long poles are 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and all 39 illegal operations. It usually lands just before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story; the 100% checklist then appears under Progress > Stats.
Work the big counts: stunts, challenges, vehicles, illegal operations.
Use the tracker filters to see which grind trophies are still open.

trophies.guide: Rack up 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count toward it. You need 300 anyway for 100%, so keep going past this one. Spread the work across Leonida while doing other cleanup instead of grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
Reach 250 for this trophy; push to 300 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types once — no need to win or master any of them. Try them early so the untouched ones stand out, and combine it with the race, fishing and arcade trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once.
Tick each type off in the tracker as you try it.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. This is a skill grind, not a count: learn each challenge's rhythm and replay the silvers until they turn gold. Short focused sessions keep your aim warm.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit both shooting ranges.
Earn gold on all 42 challenges; retry silvers until they turn gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — every location needs its own win, so clear them one by one instead of replaying a favourite. The count is locations won, not speed at one spot.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find all 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. 'Different' is the key word — twenty wins on the same race will not do it. Spread across race types and places, and note which ones you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races across types and locations.
Do not repeat one race: only first wins on new races count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal head to head in a fishing challenge. Learn the reeling rhythm instead of rushing it. Fishing also feeds Combat Focus — roughly a tenth of the meter per fish — which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and win.
Fish between other tasks: each fish also tops up Combat Focus.

trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to its end. Finishing is the requirement, not a high score — pick the cabinet you like best. It also covers one activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade and play one game to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand with its final mission. The fine print: Andy's strand has its own trophy, so it does not count toward the eight strands Strangers & Freaks wants.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play Andy's mission strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: See Kenton's strand through to its final mission. Follow it as the story presents it and the trophy lands at the finale.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's strand to its final mission. Like Andy's and Tyrone's, Billy's strand has its own trophy and does not add to the Strangers & Freaks eight — finish it for itself.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Play Billy's mission strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger strands across Leonida. Not every questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and are excluded, so pick eight others and finish each one fully — a half-finished strand earns nothing.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish 8 stranger strands, skipping Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's (they have their own trophies).
Track each finished strand so you know how many are left.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand through to its final mission, as the story presents it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand with its final mission. Tyrone's is another strand with its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. The first spot — Lucia's balcony — only exists in Chapter 1; when the chapter ends, it is gone, and without mission replay or New Game Plus the only way back is a manual Chapter 1 save. Nearby spots show as purple icons, and taking your partner along should make each outdoor spot count for both characters at once. This is the game's only missable trophy, which is why this guide warns you about it before anything else.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony before the chapter ends.
Keep a manual Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
Meditate at all 18 spots, bringing your partner so each spot counts for both characters.
Watch for purple icons marking nearby meditation spots.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel in his hunting questline. It is Jason-only, so play as Jason for it, and follow the questline to the animal it marks.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Play as Jason for Bret Vogel's hunting questline.
Hunt the unique animal the questline marks.

trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you travel for other trophies and sweep the rest at the end. Partial sets do not count; three full sets is the target.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida as you play.
Complete 3 full card sets.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so do the two together: scan a vehicle, WAiNK the location, move on. Fold it into ordinary travel rather than grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations.
Combine it with vehicle scanning for Whip It Good.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total and 100% wants 70, so this is a milestone on a longer road — keep going after it pops. Clear the easy ones first, then work the list down during cleanup.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete 50 challenges of any kind.
Push to 70 of 80 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner with you, build a four-star wanted level and then lose it. Partner play only opens after Breakfast Run, so both characters must be together for this one. Get the heat up, break line of sight, and get out of the red zone — the pop comes once you are clear, not while you are still hiding in it.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along.
Reach a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape and leave the red heat zone until the heat clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time. If the heat dies between robberies, the chain breaks — so pick three shops close together, plan the route, and move quickly from one to the next.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Plan three nearby shops in advance and move between them quickly.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles, scanned with the WAiNK app as you find them. For 100% the target is 200 of 277, so keep scanning long after this pops. Pair it with You WAiNKer!: every trip can earn progress on both.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you discover them.
Reach 100 for this trophy; keep going to 200 of 277 for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim (L3+R3 while aiming). Fill the meter beforehand (each fish caught adds about 10%), find a fight where enemies cluster, then trigger Focus and chain five takedowns before it drains. Out of meter at four? Reset and choose a busier fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Fill the Combat Focus meter (fishing helps, about 10% per fish).
Find a fight with enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming and down 5 enemies in that one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — gates E3 and E4 work — and fly it about a kilometre away. Keep flying straight until the trophy pops once you are clear of the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane at a boarding bridge (gates E3/E4).
Steal it, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.guide: Find the Rhinos — the tanks — parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key. Go ready for heavy resistance; the trophy follows from the encounter the description hints at.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Head to the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, Goose Key.
Deal with the Rhinos (tanks) parked there.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store and rob it without anyone spotting you. The work opens in Chapter 3, when jewelry jobs appear — Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs supply the Snap Gun — and Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a solid first target. Stay out of sight from entry to exit: being seen even once ruins the run, so back out and try the approach again instead of shooting your way out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Unlock jewelry jobs in Chapter 3 (Snap Gun via Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs).
Pick a target such as Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
Rob it without being detected at any point.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, each robbed and escaped from. The vaults come from the optional mission near the end of Chapter 4, so say yes to optional content in that chapter. Take your partner along, and do not expect the pop mid-chase: it only lands once you are out of the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Take the optional bank-vault mission near the end of Chapter 4.
Bring your partner.
Rob 5 bank vaults, escaping and leaving the red heat zone each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Like the vaults, this is a Chapter 4 robbery trophy: find a truck on the road, hit it, and get clear of the heat. Leaving the red zone seals it.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck in Chapter 4 or later.
Rob it and escape, leaving the red heat zone.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in total. It mostly happens by itself if you travel widely for other trophies, but a few corners are easy to miss, so sweep the map deliberately at the end: drive, fly and sail into every named area until all 52 are visited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through every named area of Leonida (52 in total).
Sweep the map's corners deliberately during cleanup.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation from each of the nine gangs — one per gang is enough. For 100% the target is all 39 operations, so this is the first third of a bigger job. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit so none is missed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
For 100%, keep going until all 39 operations are robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find the cocktail spot with the view, and order one. Nothing to fight and nothing to grind — this trophy is just about being in the right place and letting the moment play out.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find the cocktail spot with the view.
Order and enjoy the cocktail.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom and crash back out through the front glass, old-school style. Pick your car inside, then leave the way the series taught you years ago. One attempt, one trophy.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way out through the front in a car.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper game, following through on your throws the way the game demonstrates. While you are there, Ten Pin — the melee drive-by — pairs well with the trip.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl and follow through on your throws.

trophies.guide: Raise Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia at a gym. Work on one character, switch, and work on the other; the trophy arrives when the second of the two maxes out. It is slow, so train a little between other jobs instead of grinding it in one go.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Train at a gym as Jason until Strength is maxed.
Switch to Lucia and train her Strength to max too.

trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It tracks the choices you make across the game, for better or worse, so it grows as you play with intent. No shortcut: keep making decisions and taking actions, and the count reaches 500 across a full playthrough plus cleanup.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Keep making profile-changing choices and actions as you play.
The count reaches 500 across a full playthrough plus cleanup.

trophies.guide: Fail at something, then clear it on the very next attempt. The description says it plainly: second time's the charm. Tricky missions and activities will probably hand you this one by accident; if cleanup arrives and it still has not popped, choose an activity you can fail on purpose and pass on the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt at something, then succeed on the immediate second try.

trophies.guide: Run into something strange out in Leonida. The description keeps the trigger vague on purpose, so there is no checklist for it — poke around the map's odd corners and easter-egg spots until the event finds you. Consider it a reward for exploring, not a job to force.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's unusual locations and events.
The trophy pops when you witness the strange event it tracks.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: a melee weapon swung from a moving car. Pick a quiet road, line up a person on foot, and swing as you pass. One clean hit does it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive past a target on foot and land a melee drive-by that bowls them over.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Bank jobs and payday loan jobs supply the bills, and the total builds up over time — there is no need to do it in a single run. Launder after each bank job and the number climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from bank and payday loan jobs.
Launder them through your contacts.
Repeat until $250,000 is laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops. Weapons, clothes, food — all of it counts, so normal spending gets you most of the way. During cleanup, top up the remainder on expensive items.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shops as you play.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: Own all eight garages, about $160,000 altogether. They are sold through the Vice City Real Estate app, which appears after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. Buy them whenever you can afford one — each garage also gives you somewhere to keep the cars you register for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Unlock the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy all 8 garage properties (about $160,000 total).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Put ten vehicles on the Scooter Bros app. It unlocks with the Moses mission in Chapter 2. For each car: steal it, respray it, register it — ten times, ten different vehicles. Every car you find also counts as a vehicle discovered for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app in the Moses mission (Chapter 2).
Steal a car, respray it, then register it.
Repeat for 10 vehicles.

verification: Rockstar has not published an official trophy list. Names, descriptions and grades below are as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every entry; how-to notes are paraphrased in this guide's own words from the Outputlag trophy guide, cross-checked against Keengamer and Radio Times. Treat every how-to as third-party guidance, not Rockstar's own words.
